    SELECT 
        gmap_id,
        name,
        address,
        avg_rating,
        -- get the street string (usually before the first comma, or second if first is place name)

            THEN trim(split_part(address, ',', 2))

    regexp_replace(raw_street_line, '^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?\s+', '') as street_name_full
FROM parsed_addr

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        gmap_id,
        name,
        address,
        avg_rating,
        regexp_extract(address, '([0-9]+\s+(?:[NSEW]\.?\s+)?[^,]+)', 1) as raw_street
    FROM establishments
    WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND address != ''
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(raw_street, '^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?\s+', ''),
            '\s+(#|Ste|Suite|Unit| Bldg| Dept| Apt).*', '', 'i'
        ) as street_full,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(raw_street, '^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?\s+', ''),
                '^(N|S|E|W|North|South|East|West)\.?\s+', '', 'i'
            ),
            '\s+(#|Ste|Suite|Unit| Bldg| Dept| Apt).*', '', 'i'
        ) as street_nodir
    FROM parsed
    WHERE raw_street != ''
)
SELECT 
    '3.0 - 3.9 rating' as rating_group,
    street_full,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM cleaned
WHERE avg_rating >= 3.0 AND avg_rating < 4.0
GROUP BY street_full
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        gmap_id,
        address,
        avg_rating,
        regexp_extract(address, '([0-9]+\s+(?:[NSEW]\.?\s+)?[^,]+)', 1) as raw_street
    FROM establishments
    WHERE address IS NOT NULL AND address != '' AND avg_rating >= 3.0 AND avg_rating < 4.0
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT 
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(raw_street, '^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?\s+', ''),
                '^(N|S|E|W|North|South|East|West)\.?\s+', '', 'i'
            ),
            '\s+(#|Ste|Suite|Unit| Bldg| Dept| Apt).*', '', 'i'
        ) as street_name
    FROM parsed
    WHERE raw_street != ''
)
SELECT 
    street_name,
    COUNT(*) as restaurant_count
FROM cleaned
WHERE street_name IS NOT NULL AND street_name != ''
GROUP BY street_name
ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC
LIMIT 10
